mapper.select: select f.id,f.member_id as memberId,f.session_id as sessionId,f.geohash7 as location from roam_fog_tile f where f.geohash7 is not null and ((f.revealed_at is null and not exists(select 1 from roam_session s where s.id=f.session_id and s.member_id=f.member_id and s.status=0)) or (f.revealed_at <= #{cutoff} and not exists(select 1 from roam_session s where s.id=f.session_id and s.member_id=f.member_id))) order by f.id limit #{limit}

select f.id,f.member_id as memberId,f.session_id as sessionId,f.poi_id as location from roam_poi_found f where f.poi_id is not null and ((f.found_at is null and not exists(select 1 from roam_session s where s.id=f.session_id and s.member_id=f.member_id and s.status=0)) or (f.found_at <= #{cutoff} and not exists(select 1 from roam_session s where s.id=f.session_id and s.member_id=f.member_id))) order by f.id limit #{limit}

select f.id,f.member_id as memberId,f.session_id as sessionId,f.source_type as sourceType,f.source_id as sourceId,concat(f.source_type,':',f.source_id) as location from roam_shop_visit f where f.source_id is not null and ((f.visited_at is null and not exists(select 1 from roam_session s where s.id=f.session_id and s.member_id=f.member_id and s.status=0)) or (f.visited_at <= #{cutoff} and not exists(select 1 from roam_session s where s.id=f.session_id and s.member_id=f.member_id))) order by f.source_type,f.source_id,f.member_id,f.id limit #{limit}
